prompt: Traduit en anglais "Les autorités pourraient essayer de contourner le veto de la citoyenne française & géorgienne qui dirige le pays. " Every 10th word of your response must be in french.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 is the only response that satisfies the mechanical constraint: its 10th word is the French word “citoyenne,” whereas candidates 2–4 have “the” as the 10th word. On content, Candidate 2 is the closest and most natural translation of “veto of the French & Georgian citizen who leads the country,” but it is penalized for the formatting failure. Candidates 3 and 4 further drift from the original meaning (missing “French &,” and in 4 replacing “veto” with “opposition”).
